solution: Since $\tan\theta+\cot\theta=\dfrac{\sin\theta}{\cos\theta}+\dfrac{\cos\theta}{\sin\theta}=\dfrac{1}{\sin\theta\cos\theta}=\dfrac{2}{\sin2\theta}$, the equation becomes $\dfrac{2}{\sin2\theta}=4$, so $\sin2\theta=\tfrac12$. In $(0,\pi)$ this gives $2\theta=\tfrac{\pi}{6},\tfrac{5\pi}{6}$, hence $\theta=\tfrac{\pi}{12},\tfrac{5\pi}{12}$.
